essence: Joy risen, dissolved into: of that mind may be.
Eating-drinking joy's bloom: fancy the filled state.
Tasted objects' happiness: absorbed into one-selfness.
Sleep's outer range perished: supreme goddess shines.
Dappled sky gaze fixed: own self-form shines.
Skeleton, anger, licking, sky-going: attainment shines.
Armpit-sky half-bent arms: calm by dissolving.
Fixed gaze cast down: unsupported mind, Śiva.

rasa.dominant: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness at the edge of intensity)
rasa.justification: Every verse ends a blaze into a still noun — mind, state, selfness, form — the fierce pretexts (skeleton, anger, dark sky) are all converted; the rasa is quiet where the material burns.

sections.SUMMARY: Where bliss dissolves into what remains: meditated joy becoming that mind; eating and drinking's bloom fancyed as the filled state; tasted objects absorbed into one-selfness; content mind held until supreme-bliss-own-form proceeds; sleep's perished outer range as the goddess' shining; gaze fixed in dappled sky showing self-form; the fierce gazes — skeleton, anger, licking, sky-going — all yielding attainment at their time; the asymmetric seat making mind full; half-bent arms in armpit-sky giving calm; and fixed gaze cast down making unsupported mind go to Śiva.
sections.FUNCTION: Converts intensity into positions: every blazing experience is seated, gazed, and stilled.
sections.KEY TERMS: bharitā (filled state); eka-tā (one-selfness); dṛṣṭi (gaze as the operative sense); āsana (seat-variation); svātmarūpa (self-form as what shines).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Sleep-range (v75) sets up the coming sleep-practices; skeleton/sky gaze continue to p09.
sections.BOUNDARY: The fierce gazes are listed, not explained — no taxonomies of fear added.
sections.EXPLANATION: This block is the hinge from bliss to position: joy must dissolve to leave only mind, the filling must be fancyed to become full, other's objects tasted until they are oneself, and contentment held in place until own-form proceeds forth. Then the senses take over as instruments — dappled sky, sleep's edge, and the deliberately fierce images (skeleton, anger, licking) whose point is the conversion: gaze fixed, even there, attainment shines. The body is arranged into asymmetric, half-bent, downward-cast postures, each producing the next stillness: fullness, calm, unsupported mind.
sections.RELATED: Hareesh notes extreme practices (piercing flesh, dark sky) as intensity-doors — same cluster here; Lakshman Joo's practical notes per Singh for postures.
